// diagnostic

E0965

An index interval is out of range for a `[T#N]` at compile time.

What

An index interval is out of range for a `[T#N]` at compile time.

Why

Literal indexes and interval facts must fit 0 through N−1; anything outside that range would panic at runtime.

Fix

use an index in the valid range, widen to `[T]` for runtime checking, or tighten the range.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0965: tests/ui/fixed_list_index_bounds.stderr.

Error [E0965]: index 5 is out of range for a fixed-size list of 3 elements
  --> tests/ui/fixed_list_index_bounds.jet:3:18
    |
  3 |     print(result[5])
    |                  ^
 Why: the valid indexes for `[T#N]` are 0 through N-1
 Fix: use an index between 0 and 2
